narrative_purpose: Makes the two readings of Eywa visible at once: the same root-and-tree network read as a revered All-Mother presence and as measurable electrochemical infrastructure — the deity/substrate duality the chapter must reconcile.
subject: A single vast Pandoran tree-and-root system seen in cross-section, split down the middle by treatment rather than a hard line: on the left half the roots and trunk are rendered as a soft, reverent, glowing presence, light pooling around a kneeling Na'vi silhouette resting a hand on the trunk; on the right half the very same roots are rendered as a precise web of fine bright filaments threading between many tree bases underground, dense nodes where roots meet glowing like synapses, a clinical clarity to the wiring.
scene: Forest floor and the soil beneath it cut away to show the root mesh, the canopy above dissolving into haze, a faint underground lattice extending past the frame on both sides.
camera: A straight-on elevation view, the tree centred, the ground cut away to reveal the root web below.
light: Left half: diffuse, warm-leaning reverent glow pooling softly. Right half: cooler, sharper bioluminescent filament-light picking out individual root junctions as bright nodes.
palette: Cool ocean-teal and Pandora cyan dominant throughout; the left half carries the faintest ember warmth in its glow, the right half stays pure cyan filament-light; warm kept scarce.
style: Painterly speculative-biology naturalist plate with faint diagrammatic clarity on the right half, hand-painted texture.
detail_level: Crisp on the trunk and the brightest root junctions; the deeper lattice and canopy dissolving into haze.
composition: Tree centred and vertical, kneeling Na'vi small at lower left, the root web spreading symmetrically below; open dark soil regions left and right for callout labels.
exclude: hard dividing line down the middle
consistency_notes: Same cool Pandora palette and from-within glow as the chapter cover; Na'vi anatomy consistent with other plates; keep dark space beside the root junctions for labels.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no diagram labels, no arrows, no photographic or 3D-render look, no lens flares, no neon UI glow, no cartoon or anime style
